scope: Movie list filter/sort helper only; synthetic in-process Node measurements, not live browser timings
head: be511f98846a67a182e5b371ad087938e9344362
cause: The helper merged metadata and built genre tokens for every row even with default filters; sort comparators merged metadata twice per comparison.
fix: Default filters return a membership copy without metadata reads. Active predicates inspect only their fields. Filter/sort reads metadata once per member and calculates sort keys once before the stable sort.

fixture.rows: Owned rows with 30 extra canonical fields; metadata callback uses the same item, canonical_metadata and ownedPayload spread order as MovieListsWorkspace
fixture.sampling: One warm-up then median of five runs; all rows pass the active predicates; metadata read counts recorded per run

coverage: once per row canonical metadata merges

limits: Timings depend on host load and synthetic field shape. This does not measure metadata HTTP enrichment, list model construction, React rendering or browser interaction. No runtime restart, configuration/data change, commit, push or main-checkout edit occurred. Root agent handles compiled UI and live-browser gates.
